query: I just picked up a new lavender scented candle on my way home today, it fills the whole living room with such a soft, calming fragrance, I’ve been lighting it while I catch up on my favorite drama series all afternoon. The latest episode had such a surprising plot twist, I didn’t even see it coming at all, I had to pause and rewatch that scene twice to make sure I didn’t miss anything. Oh, and my cat just knocked over a mug of iced tea onto the couch earlier, I just finished mopping up the mess and I’m still a little flustered about it. Anyway, I’m having some issues with my phone right now: I keep getting bad network connection, my wifi calling isn’t working at all, my SMS app seems to be having permission problems so I can’t send or receive texts, my mobile data mode is off, I think my SIM card might be unseated, and I’m currently abroad with roaming turned off, I need help figuring out how to fix these issues.
